body: @taquitos I changed it on my end, was going to do a PR. No rush, if you don't get to it, I'll do it
@acegreen thanks, the fix just got merged. Let me know if you find anything else, I had a feeling a few of these might slip through.
@taquitos I see a bunch of get....() methods that have no return in that file. I would return String for all of them

That's a great point. One thing that prevented me from doing that is some of those only store a file somewhere, or they save an object in the lane context for later use. Maybe in those cases we could return a path, or update the action to return the value too.

Ah true, just to keep it simple for now, maybe for the obvious ones return String. And in the future, with more use-cases it will be clear what to do with the exceptions you mentioned

On a side note, I noticed fast lane swift doesn't have a deploy_to_fabric equivalent, I thought it would be something like uploadToFabric(...)

EDIT: apparently its just crashlytics()
